documents.text:
Dear Graphcore hiring team,

I am applying for the Graduate Cloud Platform Engineer 2027 role at Graphcore.

I set up a three-node k3s cluster on old office desktops for our robotics society. Members could run simulation jobs without fighting over one laptop. The other members ran their jobs on it.

Pods could not pull images for a whole week. University proxy settings were missing from containerd. I wrote the containerd proxy fix. We fixed it in the end.

Thank you for considering my application.

Kind regards,
